title: Strengthen the fts5_locale() function against integer overflow attacks,
bug_discussion:
Official SQLite Fossil fixing commit https://sqlite.org/src/info/f0dbd9d22f558dd002e2132381de3c82d55a670399b3e527b5962b025141676a

Strengthen the fts5_locale() function against integer overflow attacks,
even when SQLite is compiled with oversize values for
SQLITE_MAX_LENGTH.

FossilOrigin-Name: f0dbd9d22f558dd002e2132381de3c82d55a670399b3e527b5962b025141676a

Preliminary source observation: fts5_locale() combined user text and locale lengths in signed int before allocation; patch widens them. Oversize SQLITE_MAX_LENGTH build is required.
No separate public issue was identified. Review security impact, input reachability, earliest relevant fix, and whether the testcase demonstrates the target before task construction.
